repair_summary: Clarified ready-to-eat refrigerated tofu and package-directed pearl use across locales; documented supported freeze-and-stir technique and cold handling; removed unverified pearl-freezing texture and one-week storage claims.

issues.description: 四語步驟已明確使用 300 g 冷藏即食嫩豆腐與 50 g 即煮珍珠，原有兩項未使用食材警示是名稱比對未辨識簡稱的機械誤判；外部來源只支持一般的冷凍攪拌技巧、食材標示與保存處理，並未驗證本配方。實際凍結／定型時間、質地、成品份量與封面圖相符性仍待真人試作確認。
issues.suggested_fix: 以四語列出的份量和器具完成真人試作，記錄實際凍結及定型時間、質地與成品份量，並核對封面圖；試作前維持 Warning 與現行索引資格。

mechanical_review.disposition: The two prior unused_ingredient warnings were heuristic false positives: all four locale step lists explicitly use 300 g ready-to-eat silken tofu in the base and cook the listed 50 g tapioca pearls according to the package. No listed ingredient is unaccounted for.
